messages:
maria (SecEng): Heads-up: incoming external pen test scheduled next Wed. Need to lock down RBAC scope, KMS access window, and audit log collection plan. Can folks +1 availability for a short triage tomorrow?

sam (Platform): +1. I can do a quick pass on ephemeral role flow and KMS proxy timebox. What time?

arjun (Oncall): I can join earlier in the day (09:30 PT). We should confirm what evidence we need from oncall so we don't scramble during the window.

lisa (SRE): 09:30 works for me. Also add retention slices: 30d hot, 365d cold. We need to confirm SIEM ingestion paths for post-PT queries.

maria (SecEng): Great. Main asks for the triage: 1) exact RBAC changed surfaces (service accounts + admin consoles) 2) temporary KMS access (read-only decrypt for test) + rotation plan 3) audit log sampling and export URIs (SIEM + S3 evidence bucket) 4) remediation tracker + retest slots.

sam (Platform): For RBAC: propose using an ephemeral role bind approach (OIDC short-lived tokens). If approved, we can create an 'pt-assessors' role with tight constraints. Example policy snippet: ```
# example AWS assume role trust
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"Federated\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.redwood.local\"},\"Action\":\"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity\",\"Condition\":{\"NumericLessThan\":{\"aws:MultiFactorAuthAge\":\"300\"}}}]
}
```
This keeps long-lived creds out of the picture.

arjun (Oncall): That looks good. For the KMS piece: we should avoid giving decrypt across entire keyring. Limit to a single key alias and add an external access log on the key policy. Also schedule a key rotation immediately after retest.

lisa (SRE): For auditing: we'll export CloudTrail to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/<eng>/<date>/ and ensure SIEM pulls that prefix. We'll enable object-level logging to capture GetObject events. I'll hand off the bucket policy in the meeting.

maria (SecEng): I'll create the remediation tracker (spreadsheet + ticket template) and pre-populate with expected vuln buckets: auth, KMS misuse, log retention, privileged roles. Link: https://go/internal/pt/track/pt-4301 (placeholder). Please add owners.

security-bot: New PT intake created (ticket #PT-4301) by maria. Intake doc: https://go/internal/pt/intake/4301. Assigned: maria, sam, lisa.

sam (Platform): Quick Q: will assessors need console access or is API-only sufficient? Console access increases blast radius. Recommend API-only + screenshots submitted.

maria (SecEng): API-only preferred. If assessor requests console, we require a screen-share session with an engineer and ephemeral console session via bastion — we won't hand over persistent admin console creds.

arjun (Oncall): Retest coordination: propose two retest windows (one week after fixes, and a follow-up slot 3 weeks later). I'll block tentative slots on calendar after we track remediation progress.

lisa (SRE): Ops checklist for the triage call: 1) confirm S3 path and SIEM pull 2) confirm KMS alias + key policy changes staging 3) create ephemeral role in staging and test assume flow 4) snapshot logs for the pre-test baseline. I'll own snapshots.

maria (SecEng): Actions: sam -> create ephemeral role draft (action: today), lisa -> pre-test snapshots + bucket policy (action: today), arjun -> block retest slots (action: today). I'll circulate tracker and run the triage at 09:30 PT.

sam (Platform): On it. I'll paste the role manifest to the tracker once done. :thumbsup:

arjun (Oncall): Noted. If we hit blocker where KMS access can't be limited, escalate to sec-eng-oncall and we'll implement a temporary host-based decrypt proxy.

maria (SecEng): Perfect. Thanks all — see you tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll post the join link in ~30m. :eyes:
